disclaimer: All assumptions below are based on publicly available data and AI estimation, pending official survey and approval data for updates.

assumptions.statement: Total site area 286.4 ha is an estimation based on OpenStreetMap data, pending official surveying.
Greenway centerline length 15.2 km is estimated; actual construction route may deviate by +/-5%.
Green coverage rate 42% is interpreted from satellite imagery; accuracy limited by image resolution.
Carbon reduction 12400 t/yr uses IPCC urban greenspace coefficient (43.4 tCO2/ha/yr) for temperate continental climate.
Qinghe TOD FAR=2.5 is derived from Beijing general control plan norms; actual indicator requires Haidian planning approval.
New employment 12,000 estimated using industrial floor area density coefficient (141 persons/10000 sqm).
Three-phase implementation plan based on typical urban renewal project cycles; actual timeline depends on funding and policy.
